title: Read between the strokes with PencilKit
description: Unlock handwriting recognition in your apps using the same powerful technology behind Apple apps like Freeform and Notes. Discover how to use handwriting recognition across a wide range of alphabets and languages, and explore new capabilities for integrating PencilKit into a wider variety of apps.

codeSnippets.title: Recognized text
codeSnippets.code:
import PencilKit

let recognizer = PKStrokeRecognizer()
await recognizer.updateDrawing(drawing)
myLabel.text = await recognizer.recognizedText()
